icons.name: inbox
icons.heading: Inbox
icons.description: A message arrives. Light: the incoming card lifts a touch, drops into the tray and lands with a hit and one small bounce, and stays received; the tray takes the knock, dipping and springing back. Strong: a higher lift, a harder drop that bounces twice, and a deeper give in the tray. The card and tray stay rigid. The reset fades back to the card waiting above the tray.

icons.name: voicemail
icons.heading: Voicemail
icons.description: The message plays back. Light: the take-up reel on the left starts the tape, the right reel follows a beat behind, and both run one full turn, stop dead just past their marks and tick back into place. Strong: the reels wind back first, then run two fast turns, stop harder and settle in two ticks. The tape and the rims never move; the index marks show the turn.

icons.name: emoji-picker
icons.heading: Emoji picker
icons.description: The face reacts: it winks and grins. Light: the head tips toward its right eye, the eye snaps shut and opens again, and the smile widens into a grin a beat later; the head comes back past rest and settles as the grin relaxes. Strong: the head cocks the other way first, then tips further, winks, and breaks into a broad grin that holds, then swings back with two small settling beats. In Solid the wink stays open (a closed slit would close the eye's opening); the grin and the tilt carry it.

Strong: the head cocks the other way first, then tips further, winks, and breaks into a broad grin that holds, then swings back with two small settling beats. In Solid the wink stays open (a closed slit would close the eye's opening); the grin and the tilt carry it.

icons.name: rss-feed
icons.heading: RSS feed
icons.description: The feed publishes. Light: the dot fires with a pop; the outer wave travels out and fades, the inner wave travels out to take its place, and a fresh inner wave is born at the dot and swells out to its spot, overshooting a touch and settling. Strong: the dot draws in and the waves pull back first, then a bigger pop sends the outer wave further and the fresh wave lands with two settling beats. The dot never leaves its spot.

icons.name: announcement
icons.heading: Announcement
icons.description: The announcement blasts out. Light: the megaphone kicks, its bell lifting as the horn recoils, and both sound waves travel out from the bell and fade; fresh waves swell back out of the mouth, inner first, as the horn settles. Strong: the horn leans in first, then blasts twice, two syllables: each kick sends both waves out, and the horn settles after the second. The horn stays rigid.
